artists.biography: Nicholas Berkeley ('Nick') Mason (born January 27, 1944 in Birmingham, England) is a musician and the drummer for Pink Floyd.. He is the only member of Pink Floyd with the distinction of having played on all their albums. He is well-known as an automobile collector and has also competed in racing, e.g. the 24 Hours of Le Mans. He was brought up in Hampstead, London (many online biographies mistakenly cite the street address, Downshire Hill - sometimes as "the Downshire Hills" - as a district of Birmingham) and attended Frensham Heights boarding school, Surrey. He later studied at the Regent Street Polytechnic, where he teamed up with Roger Waters, Bob Klose and Richard Wright in 1964 to form Sigma 6. Read more on Last.fm. User-contributed text is available under the Creative Commons By-SA License; additional terms may apply.

perplexity.description:
Unattended Luggage is a box set compilation released in 2018 that collects Nick Mason's three solo albums from the 1980s: Nick Mason's Fictitious Sports (1981), Profiles (1985), and White of the Eye (1987). The set spans jazz-rock and progressive rock styles, showcasing Mason's work beyond his role as Pink Floyd's drummer. Available in both 3-CD and 3-LP vinyl formats, the collection marked the first reissue of these albums in over 20 years, making them widely accessible after decades of scarcity in their original vinyl editions.

Mason's solo work during this period demonstrated his versatility as a musician and producer. His 1981 debut featured collaborations with notable artists including Robert Wyatt and Carla Bley, while Profiles, created with guitarist Rick Fenn, incorporated contributions from David Gilmour and saxophonist Mel Collins. The instrumental-heavy compositions reflected Mason's experimental approach to rhythm and texture, distinguishing his solo output from his work with Pink Floyd.

The reissue arrived as Mason prepared to tour Europe with his band Nick Mason's Saucerful Of Secrets in September 2018, positioning the box set as a retrospective of his creative endeavors outside the band. Mason expressed satisfaction with the remastered recordings, noting their special significance in his musical career and hoping the reissue would generate sufficient interest to impact the market for the original rare vinyl versions.
